verdict.rationale: The INPI Guichet unique pages describe only web-portal formalities: filing, tracking, payment and signature. The register is said to be freely consultable, but nothing on INPI's own pages documents API endpoints, a key-issuance path or rate limits. The keyless JSON API in the probe is a separate state service (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), not documentation published by this product, so it cannot be credited here.
